thesis: Travis Kalanick argues that the next industrial revolution will be defined by industrial AI automating massive trillion-dollar industries like food production, delivery, and mining, fundamentally changing their business models. He emphasizes that successful founders must fight for the best idea rather than the politically expedient one to avoid settling for mediocre outcomes, noting that his current work is a continuation of the transformative vision he had for Uber.
